procedure_name: Rainwater Harvesting System Certification & Property Tax Rebate
summary: Certification of functional rainwater harvesting pits to claim up to 10% annual rebate on property tax.

steps.title: Construct RWH pit per bylaws
steps.description: Ensure recharge pit, filtration bed, and desilting chamber conform to municipal engineering specifications.

steps.title: Apply for RWH certificate
steps.description: Submit online application with property tax assessment number and plumber completion certificate.

steps.title: Site inspection by junior engineer
steps.description: JE inspects catchment slope, filter media, and injection well to confirm operational status.

steps.title: Issuance of RWH Compliance Certificate
steps.description: Executive Engineer approves certificate valid for 3 financial years.

steps.title: Automatic tax rebate linkage
steps.description: Rebate automatically applied as deduction in annual property tax bill.
